```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global chunk options
# echo = TRUE:     show code in rendered output
# warning = FALSE: suppress warnings in rendered document
#                  (warnings still print to console during knitting)
# message = FALSE: suppress package loading messages
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi        = 300
)

# save_plot(): writes a figure to PDF (outputs folder) and shows the same figure in the knitted HTML.
# The plotting code is run once for the PDF and once for a PNG copy at the same size, which is embedded in
# the HTML; when run interactively (not knitting) the plot is also drawn in the plot pane.
save_plot <- function(file, width, height, expr) {
  expr <- substitute(expr); env <- parent.frame()
  # draw on a newly opened device and close exactly that device (never whichever device happens to be current).
  # Some plotting functions move drawing away from that device: pheatmap() opens and closes a temporary device
  # (pdf(NULL) ... dev.off()) before drawing, and R then makes some other open device current, which left PDFs blank or
  # missing from the HTML. RStudio/knitr graphics hooks can do the same. While the file is drawn, those hooks are
  # replaced by one that switches back to the file's device each time a new plot page starts (plot.new / grid.newpage).
  hooks <- c("before.plot.new", "plot.new", "before.grid.newpage", "grid.newpage")
  draw_on <- function(open_device) {
    saved <- lapply(setNames(hooks, hooks), getHook)
    open_device(); d <- dev.cur()
    back_to_d <- function() if (d %in% dev.list() && dev.cur() != d) dev.set(d)
    for (h in hooks) setHook(h, NULL, "replace")
    setHook("before.plot.new", back_to_d); setHook("before.grid.newpage", back_to_d)
    on.exit({ if (d %in% dev.list()) dev.off(d)
              for (h in hooks) setHook(h, saved[[h]], "replace") })
    eval(expr, env)
  }
  draw_on(function() pdf(file = file, width = width, height = height))
  if (!isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) { # interactive: also draw in the plot pane (skipped if the pane is too small)
    ok <- try(eval(expr, env), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(ok, "try-error") && dev.cur() > 1)
      try(dev.off(dev.cur()), silent = TRUE) # reset the screen device left in a broken state (the PDF is already closed)
    return(invisible(file)) }
  png_file <- file.path(tempdir(), sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", basename(file)))
  draw_on(function() png(png_file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 150))
  if (!file.exists(png_file)) { warning("nothing was drawn for ", basename(file)); return(invisible(file)) }
  knitr::include_graphics(png_file, rel_path = FALSE, dpi = 150) # displayed at its true size
}
```


# packages

```{r packages}
# install.packages("KOGMWU")
library(KOGMWU)
library(pheatmap) # pheatmap() is used for the delta-rank heatmaps below

# loading KOG annotations
gene2kog=read.table("../../../Orbicella-faveolata-annotated-transcriptome/Ofaveolata_iso2kogClass.tab",sep="\t", fill=T)
# genes without a KOG annotation (empty class) are dropped: they are not a functional category (mostly short or
# unannotated transcripts), so they are not tested as a KOG class
gene2kog <- gene2kog[!is.na(gene2kog[, 2]) & trimws(gene2kog[, 2]) != "", ]
head(gene2kog)
```


# gene rankings

```{r gene-rankings}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KOG-MWU ranks all genes by a continuous measure and tests, for each KOG class, whether its genes rank higher or
# lower than the rest (Mann-Whitney U); the Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied across KOG classes. Two measures
# are run for every comparison:
#   rawp: signed -log10 of the unadjusted p-value (sign of the effect), as in the GO_MWU / KOG-MWU examples
#         (Matz lab). Unadjusted p is used because the BH adjustment ties many genes when few are significant.
#   lfc:  log2 fold change (as in the KOGMWU package examples); dream estimates are not shrunk, so noisy
#         low-expression genes can rank high (filterByExpr has removed the least expressed genes).
# Gene-level DEG calls elsewhere (Table S8, Venn diagrams, datasets) still use adjusted p (the *_lpv exports).
# Inputs are the full results tables saved by the limma script (no re-fitting):
#   treatments: pvals.RData (LC_CC ... LH_LC; log2FoldChange, stat, pvalue)
#   urban vs reef and site contrasts: urban_reef.RData (site_tt; logFC, t, P.Value)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
treat_env <- new.env()
load("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/pvals.RData", envir = treat_env)
site_env <- new.env()
load("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/urban_reef.RData", envir = site_env)

treat_sets <- c("LC_CC", "CH_CC", "LH_CC", "CH_LC", "LH_LC", "LH_CH")
site_sets  <- c("urban_reef", "MacN_reef", "Star_reef", "Rainbow_Emerald", "Star_Emerald", "MacN_Emerald",
                "Star_Rainbow", "MacN_Rainbow", "MacN_Star")
stopifnot(all(treat_sets %in% ls(treat_env)), all(site_sets %in% names(site_env$site_tt)))
measures <- c(rawp = "signed -log10 p (unadjusted)", lfc = "log2 fold change")

# one ranking per contrast and measure: data frame of gene and value (the two columns kog.mwu() expects)
kog_input <- function(contrast, measure) {
  if (contrast %in% site_sets) {
    x <- site_env$site_tt[[contrast]]; lfc <- x$logFC; stat <- x$t; p <- x$P.Value
  } else {
    x <- get(contrast, envir = treat_env); lfc <- x$log2FoldChange; stat <- x$stat; p <- x$pvalue
  }
  value <- if (measure == "rawp") -log10(p) * sign(stat) else lfc
  d <- data.frame(gene = rownames(x), value = value)
  d[is.finite(d$value), ]
}

# KOG-MWU for every contrast x measure (15 contrasts x 2 measures)
kog_res <- lapply(setNames(names(measures), names(measures)), function(m)
  lapply(setNames(c(treat_sets, site_sets), c(treat_sets, site_sets)), function(k) kog.mwu(kog_input(k, m), gene2kog)))

# all KOG-MWU results in one table
kog_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(kog_res), function(m) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(kog_res[[m]]), function(k)
  data.frame(measure = m, contrast = k, kog_res[[m]][[k]], row.names = NULL)))))
write.csv(kog_all, "../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_kog_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# does the measure matter? per contrast: correlation of delta ranks between measures, and KOG classes significant
# (adjusted p < 0.05) under both, only raw p, or only log fold change
measure_comparison <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(treat_sets, site_sets), function(k) {
  a <- kog_res$rawp[[k]]; b <- kog_res$lfc[[k]]
  ab <- merge(a, b, by = "term", suffixes = c("_rawp", "_lfc"))
  sa <- ab$term[ab$padj_rawp < 0.05]; sb <- ab$term[ab$padj_lfc < 0.05]
  data.frame(contrast = k,
             delta_rank_r = round(cor(ab$delta.rank_rawp, ab$delta.rank_lfc), 3),
             sig_rawp = length(sa), sig_lfc = length(sb), sig_both = length(intersect(sa, sb)),
             only_rawp = paste(setdiff(sa, sb), collapse = "; "), only_lfc = paste(setdiff(sb, sa), collapse = "; "))
}))
measure_comparison
write.csv(measure_comparison, "../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_measure_comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)

library(RColorBrewer)
# diverging palette with white fixed at zero: breaks run symmetrically from -max|delta rank| to +max
color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100)
sym_breaks <- function(m) { lim <- max(abs(m), na.rm = TRUE); seq(-lim, lim, length.out = length(color) + 1) }
kog_dir <- "../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu"

# delta-rank heatmap for a set of contrasts under one measure (file tag = measure);
# * = KOG class significant in that contrast (adjusted p < 0.05, BH across classes)
# flip dendrogram leaves towards a preferred column order without changing the tree (clustering is unchanged);
# row trees (KOG terms) pass through untouched
rotate_cols <- function(col_order) function(hc, mat) {
  if (is.null(col_order) || !all(hc$labels %in% col_order)) return(hc)
  out <- as.hclust(reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), wts = match(hc$labels, col_order), agglo.FUN = mean))
  got <- out$labels[out$order]
  if (!identical(got, col_order[col_order %in% got])) message("tree does not allow column order; closest: ", paste(got, collapse = ", "))
  out
}
kog_heatmap <- function(contrasts, stem, measure, width = 7, height = 8, col_order = NULL) {
  kt <- makeDeltaRanksTable(kog_res[[measure]][contrasts])
  sig <- sapply(colnames(kt), function(k) {
    x <- kog_res[[measure]][[k]]
    ifelse(x$padj[match(rownames(kt), x$term)] < 0.05, "*", "")
  })
  sig[is.na(sig)] <- ""
  save_plot(file = file.path(kog_dir, sprintf("KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_%s_%s.pdf", stem, measure)), width = width, height = height, {
    pheatmap(as.matrix(kt), clustering_distance_cols = "correlation", color = color, breaks = sym_breaks(as.matrix(kt)), clustering_callback = rotate_cols(col_order), cellwidth = 15, cellheight = 15,
             border_color = "white", main = measures[[measure]],
             display_numbers = matrix(sig, nrow = nrow(kt), dimnames = dimnames(kt)), number_color = "black", fontsize_number = 10)
  })
}
# delta-rank correlation plots between pairs of contrasts
kog_corr <- function(contrasts, pairs, stem, measure, mfrow, width, height) {
  kt <- makeDeltaRanksTable(kog_res[[measure]][contrasts])
  save_plot(file = file.path(kog_dir, sprintf("KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_%s_corr_%s.pdf", stem, measure)), width = width, height = height, {
    par(mfrow = mfrow)
    for (pr in pairs) corrPlot(x = pr[1], y = pr[2], kt)
  })
}
filtered_sets <- c("LC_CC", "CH_CC", "LH_CC")
urban_sets    <- c("urban_reef", filtered_sets)
```


# treatment all

```{r treatment-all}
treat_pairs <- combn(treat_sets, 2, simplify = FALSE)
kog_heatmap(treat_sets, "treatment", "rawp")
kog_heatmap(treat_sets, "treatment", "lfc")
kog_corr(treat_sets, treat_pairs, "treatment", "rawp", mfrow = c(4, 4), width = 10, height = 10)
kog_corr(treat_sets, treat_pairs, "treatment", "lfc", mfrow = c(4, 4), width = 10, height = 10)
```


# treatment filtered

```{r treatment-filtered}
# stress treatments vs control only
filtered_pairs <- combn(filtered_sets, 2, simplify = FALSE)
kog_heatmap(filtered_sets, "treatment_filtered", "rawp")
kog_heatmap(filtered_sets, "treatment_filtered", "lfc")
kog_corr(filtered_sets, filtered_pairs, "treatment_filtered", "rawp", mfrow = c(1, 3), width = 7, height = 2.5)
kog_corr(filtered_sets, filtered_pairs, "treatment_filtered", "lfc", mfrow = c(1, 3), width = 7, height = 2.5)
```


# urban vs reef

```{r urban-vs-reef}
# urban vs reef (planned contrast of the site model) next to the three stress-vs-control contrasts:
# does being urban resemble a stress response?
urban_pairs <- lapply(filtered_sets, function(k) c("urban_reef", k))
# Figure 4 column order, shared by both species (urban, OA, OA + Bleaching, Bleaching)
fig4_order <- c("urban_reef", "LC_CC", "LH_CC", "CH_CC")
kog_heatmap(urban_sets, "urban_reef", "rawp", col_order = fig4_order)
kog_heatmap(urban_sets, "urban_reef", "lfc", col_order = fig4_order)
kog_corr(urban_sets, urban_pairs, "urban_reef", "rawp", mfrow = c(1, 3), width = 7, height = 2.5)
kog_corr(urban_sets, urban_pairs, "urban_reef", "lfc", mfrow = c(1, 3), width = 7, height = 2.5)
```


# sites

```{r site-pairwise}
# urban vs reef, each urban site vs the reef sites, and the six pairwise site comparisons (first site minus second).
# KOG-MWU ranks all genes, so it can be run for contrasts with few or no individually significant genes.
kog_heatmap(site_sets, "sites", "rawp", width = 8)
kog_heatmap(site_sets, "sites", "lfc", width = 8)
for (m in names(measures))
  write.csv(makeDeltaRanksTable(kog_res[[m]][site_sets]),
            file = file.path(kog_dir, sprintf("KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_sites_delta_ranks_%s.csv", m)))

# KOG classes significant in each site contrast (adjusted p < 0.05), by measure
subset(kog_all, contrast %in% site_sets & padj < 0.05)
```
